newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to announce sale of state bank - dailies.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to announce sale of state bank - dailies.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem will announce Thursday the sale of the state-owned mortgage bank Banco Hipotecario, for which the government could reap $3.5 billion, newspapers reported.
Menem will announce his decision during the weekly Cabinet meeting, to be held in the Olivos residential palace in the morning, La Nacion and Ambito Financiero newspapers said.

The bank earned a net profit of $320 million in 1995 and is expected to make a similar figure this year. Banco Hipotecario is a wholesale institution that provides about $750 million in loans a year to other banks.
Menem's announcement would come just as unions are set to start a 36-hour general strike against the government's economic austerity plan.
Analysts say the announcement would be a sign of defiance against unions, signalling that his economic policies will not be derailed by labor pressure.
